apply_autoaugment_cifar10: apply the CIFAR10 AutoAugment policy to a TensorFlow image tensor for data augmentation
apply_cutout_augmentation: apply cutout augmentation to a TensorFlow image tensor by masking a random region with a replace value
apply_solarize_augmentation: apply solarize augmentation to a TensorFlow image tensor by inverting pixels above a threshold
apply_image_blend: blend two TensorFlow image tensors together using a floating point interpolation factor
apply_autocontrast_augmentation: apply autocontrast augmentation to a TensorFlow image tensor by scaling each channel independently
